name: qlrisk_price_swaption
title: Price a Swaption
description: Price one qlrisk Swaption (Swaption - option to enter into a swap; interest_rate, interest_rate): NPV in the trade currency and the reporting currency, pricing components, analytic Greeks where the pricer gives them, and optional cash flows. Inputs are this product's fields only; required: option_expiry, swap_effective, swap_maturity, notional, strike. Market data defaults to qlrisk's sample snapshot valued today; override curves, spots and vols, or apply shocks, with market_data as in qlrisk_price_trades. For a book of several products use qlrisk_price_trades. Example: {"notional": 1000000, "option_expiry": "2027-10-11", "swap_effective": "2027-10-13", "swap_maturity": "2032-10-13", "strike": 0.04}.
